scope.description: ReadIndex prefix release and remote result identity in a stable leader term and unchanged voting membership after a current-term entry has committed.
assumptions: Crash-free execution with valid known peers and non-Byzantine messages produced by those peers
Distinct nonzero-low contexts for concurrently pending requests
Message loss is permitted; surviving messages retain their per-route order
Peer caller processes and persists updates before sending ordinary messages
excluded: No numeric completion bound, eventual successful client completion, or permanent resource-retention proposition
No membership change, restart, Byzantine traffic, context collision, storage fault or snapshot during the observed read suffix

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: Replaces asynchronous engine/transport with a synchronous persist-before-send Peer driver and FIFO queue; protocol logic is unchanged.
Uses captured TestLogDB and applies only initialization config/no-op entries; excludes crash durability and user application execution.

plan_uncertainties: No full NodeHost completion/timeout observation or linearizable application read is included.
A non-release yields only a vacuous implication result for that operation; actual release is reported explicitly.
